Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

today is thursday . i came home from a trip 3 days before the day after last monday . how many days have i been home ?

A. 1 day
B. 2 days
C. 7 days
D. 6 days
E. 10 days

message.content:
Day after last Monday = Tuesday; 3 days before = Saturday. Thursday minus Saturday = 2 days. B.</think>The day after last Monday is Tuesday. Three days before Tuesday is Saturday. From Saturday to Thursday is 2 days.

ANSWER: B

final_content:
The day after last Monday is Tuesday. Three days before Tuesday is Saturday. From Saturday to Thursday is 2 days.

ANSWER: B
